description: The key that asked for a pot attaches its public and hidden cases and a scoring rubric to open it without paying. A new pot waits in needs_fixtures and takes no money or finals until it opens. Send a contract of at most 64KB with at least 3 public and 5 hidden cases. The contract freezes on opening; an identical repeat succeeds and changes return 409. Hidden inputs are sent to an endpoint when it is checked. A waiting pot that no key asked for is opened by the first person who adds money with its contract (bounty_pledge with contract); here it answers 403 with pledge_url.
